# OG Streamz (OG BOT)

> Type an idea and OG BOT cooks a full song with real vocals, cover art and foul-mouth diss tracks if you want them. Battle the bot, earn OG Coins, VIP on us.

Also known as OG BOT, OG Bot, OGBot and OG Studio. Website: https://ogbot.co.uk. Also available as an Android and iPhone app. Based in the UK.

Turn any idea into a hit in seconds. Drill, afrobeats, pop or savage roasts — your words, real vocals, cover art included.

## What you can do

- Make a song: type your idea (a name, a roast, a memory), pick the vibe (choose a style and mood), and OG Bot cooks it — your song + cover, ready to play.
- Foul Mouth Mode: beast bot roasts, raw bars, full foul-mouth diss tracks cooked from your words. Turn the heat from Mild to Demon.
- 2 tracks for the price of 1: unlock your first take and the second one is yours free.
- 15 days of free VIP: every style unlocked from signup — drill, bhangra, afrobeats and more.
- Battle the bot: land your best roasts in Battle Zone and earn OG Coins every round.
- Lifetime referral commission: share your link — earn coins every time your friends spend, for life.
- Daily drop: pop in each day and claim your free coin drop.

Free account in seconds · 15 days of VIP on us · No card needed.
